name: esp32
description: Espressif ESP32 (ESP32-D0WD/D0WDQ6: dual Xtensa LX6 up to 240 MHz, 520 KB SRAM, external SPI flash, WiFi/BT) with Arduino-ESP32 / ESP-IDF; Renode ESP32 models with a behavioural boot ROM, LilyGO T-Beam V1.1 board (SX1278 LoRa, AXP192, NEO-6M GPS, SSD1306)

toolchain.notes: Applications are Arduino sketches or ESP-IDF projects: build with arduino-cli (FQBN esp32:esp32:t-beam or esp32:esp32:esp32; ${RENODE_ROOT}/tools/esp32/examples/build_examples.sh wraps it) and boot the 4 MB merged image (<sketch>.ino.merged.bin: bootloader at 0x1000, partition table at 0x8000, app at 0x10000). build_firmware's bare compile is for objects only; there is no bare-metal start-up for this part.

image.notes: Boot like the chip: load the boot ROM ({kind: elf, path: ${RENODE_ROOT}/tools/esp32/bootrom/esp32_bootrom.elf}) and the flash image with 'spi1.flash LoadImage @image.bin 0'; the ROM loads the 2nd-stage bootloader, which verifies and maps the app; the app starts the second core.

renode.notes: Two cores: cpu0 (PRO) and cpu1 (APP). Console on uart0 ('uart0 CreateFileBackend @file true'). Pins: 'gpio PinLevel <n>', 'gpio RecordPin <n>' / 'gpio PinEdges <n>', 'gpio OnGPIO <n> true|false'. T-Beam: AXP192 'axp BatteryVoltage 3.7', 'axp VbusVoltage 0', 'axp PressPowerKey'; GPS 'gps Latitude', 'gps Longitude', 'gps SpeedKnots', 'gps Satellites'; LoRa 'spi3.lora PacketsSent', 'spi3.lora LastSentPacket', 'spi3.lora InjectPacket "<hex>"', boards talk through 'emulation CreateIEEE802_15_4Medium "air"' + 'connector Connect spi3.lora air'; OLED 'oled Render'; button 'user_button Press'/'Release'. eFuse MAC 'efuse Mac "24:0A:C4:12:34:56"'. No WiFi/Bluetooth, PSRAM or ADC conversions. Run Renode with an open stdin (its console reader spins on EOF). Docs: tools/esp32/README.md and PERIPHERALS.md.

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with Arduino-ESP32 4.0 sketches and LilyGO T-Beam examples (tools/esp32/examples/run_examples.py, examples.txt) and the Meshtastic 2.7.26 tbeam release image
